T2S is operating normally. The previous incident impacting the ICBO event (Intraday CBO cut-off) has been resolved. The IFOP event (Intraday FoP cut-off) closed at 18:39.

T2S is currently facing an incident impacting the ICBO event (Intraday CBO cut-off). As a result of the incident, the operating day is blocked and the IFOP event (Intraday FoP cut-off) did not start. The incident does not have any impact on any other T2S functionality. The Eurosystem is taking all measures necessary to resolve the incident as soon as possible. Updated information will be provided at the latest by 19:00.

There is currently no incident in T2S. However, the operating day schedule has been changed, due to a request by a Central Securities Depository. The start of the EUR delivery versus payment cut-off (event IDVP) has been postponed by 60 minutes (from 16:00 to 17:00). Consequently, the Reimbursement of Auto-collateralisation instructions (event RMIC) and the Optional Cash Sweep (event OCSW) have also been delayed and will take place 15 minutes after closure of the delivery-versus-payment cut-off. The second optional cash sweep (event OCS2) to CLM remains at 17:45 and the; free of payment cut-off (event IFOP) remains at 18:00.

T2S is closed. The T2S operator is performing internal testing activities in the production environment during the weekend maintenance window of 11 â 12 July. Normally, during the maintenance window, instructions are queued. Due to the testing activities, messages via SWIFT towards T2S during the testing period between Saturday at 05:00 CEST until, maximum, to Sunday at 13:00 CEST, will be rejected with the NACK status. T2S Actors will need to resend any rejected messages to T2S once the maintenance window has closed with the early reopening on Sunday, 12 July at 23:00 CEST.
